evals.prompt: Add a plugin that suggests chapter markers from the transcript (title + source time for each chapter).
evals.expected_output: A new plugins/<id> made with cutpilot-plugin new --kind tools, turned into a workspace plugin (@cutpilot/plugin-tools-<name>, workspace:* SDK, tsconfig extending the base, root tsconfig reference, plugins/README row), one extra tool with .describe() on every field and source-ms times, in-memory tests plus testPlugin() behind skipIf(!dist), an icon, a README, AGENTS.md kept, pnpm format && pnpm check green, nothing imported from outside the repo.

evals.prompt: The sound plugin should fail with a useful message when the data folder isn't writable.
evals.expected_output: A PluginFailure with a new E_ code, a one-line message and a fix naming the dataDir setting; no console.log; a test for the failure code; nothing else in the plugin changed; pnpm check green.

evals.prompt: Make cloud-transcribe support a third provider.
evals.expected_output: The provider added to the manifest's choice setting, its host in permissions.network and its key in permissions.secrets, a recorded response fixture so CI needs no network, tests of the mapping to timed words in source ms with end >= start, README and plugins/README updated, cutpilot range unchanged unless a new engine capability is needed, pnpm format && pnpm check green, version left at its current value.
